Class TableKit

java.lang.Object
stockly.ui.TableKit
public final class TableKit extends Object
Shared table-chrome helpers for STOCKLY.

Centralises every custom-painted piece used by data tables so the inventory screen stays readable and consistent:

  • TableKit.StatusPill — fully rounded stock-status badge with centred text and status-appropriate pastel colours.
  • TableKit.StatusCellRenderer — table-cell renderer producing a correctly sized TableKit.StatusPill.
  • TableKit.ActionCellRenderer — row action buttons (view / edit / delete) drawn with the vector Icon set.
  • TableKit.StyledComboUI — combo box with a custom-drawn arrow that matches the text-field styling.
  • TableKit.SearchBox — rounded search field with the magnifier icon painted inside it.
  • rowBackground(int, boolean, int) — single source for zebra / hover / selection row colours.

    • rowBackground

      public static Color rowBackground(int row, boolean selected, int hoverRow)
      Computes the background colour for a table row so every column — including badges and the actions cell — shares the same stripe, hover and selection state.
      Parameters:
      row - view row index
      selected - whether the row is selected
      hoverRow - currently hovered row, or -1
      Returns:
      the background colour to paint
